reason: The hypothesis directly restates the findings and future-work implications of P6, P8, and P31, which already studied the effect of spray distance on coating thickness, porosity, oxidation, and hardness for a very similar FeNiCoCrMo0.5Al1.3 HEA using HVOF. The proposed intervention, mechanism, and predicted outcome are taken from those passages without adding a new material, regime, or integrative insight.
copied_elements: reducing spray distance to increase particle velocity and deposition efficiency
mechanism linking shorter distance to higher kinetic energy, better splat formation, and denser coating
prediction of thicker coating with lower porosity and controlled oxidation
use of HVAF/HVOF and FeCoNiCrAl-based HEA powder
